verdict.rationale: Groq's own LoRA docs say users can upload existing LoRA adapters and run inference with them on Groq's infrastructure, so the adapter-serving half of the story is directly documented. Nothing in the evidence shows uploading full custom model weights, and the LoRA docs are thin on base-model support, the upload workflow and access requirements, with no community or hands-on confirmation. missing for 10: upload/serving of full custom model weights, documented upload workflow and supported base models for LoRA, independent or hands-on corroboration of LoRA serving.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can upload and serve my own custom model weights or LoRA adapters
